subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should OpenClaw core accept this folder-backed encrypted backup/restore config surface after the security and proof blockers are fixed, or should the work wait behind the canonical backup/restore design issue?
rationale: The PR adds new backup config, command aliases, encrypted snapshot storage, and destructive restore behavior, which crosses product, compatibility, and security boundaries beyond a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep as core candidate after blockers
options.body: Keep this PR open only if maintainers want this core backup surface and expect the contributor or an adopter to rebase, fix the blockers, and provide real proof.

options.title: Route to the canonical issue
options.body: Pause or close this branch and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13616 for the remaining native backup/restore design and security review.

options.title: Prefer external/off-machine backup first
options.body: Defer core snapshot storage and point users to plugin/ClawHub-style off-machine backup options until a smaller core API gap is identified.

recommendation.title: Keep as core candidate after blockers
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open only if maintainers want this core backup surface and expect the contributor or an adopter to rebase, fix the blockers, and provide real proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main owner signal for the existing backup CLI surface in the available history.
